source_evidence: REITs provide a way for individual investors to earn a share of the income produced through commercial real estate ownership – without actually having to go out and buy commercial real estate.
question: How can a REIT let an individual benefit from commercial real estate without buying property directly?
answer: A REIT owns and typically operates income-producing real estate or related assets. By investing in its shares, an individual can earn a share of the income from commercial real estate without personally purchasing the property.
